purpose: The last ask at the end of a landing page, followed by a hatched closing frame with no rules of its own, because the site footer under it opens with one. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `call-to-action`, `button`, `frame-box` and `texture-material`. `kind` picks the layout only: `split` sets the headline and the primary action in a raised lead cell beside an aside cell carrying the description and the secondary action, over a tall closing frame; `panel` sets the copy and its actions on one surface, over a short closing frame; `primary` is the loud close, one centred ask on the canvas under a pixelated texture whose waves keep travelling, over a tall closing frame. All three take the same copy and the same two actions.
useWhen: To close a solution or product page on its one or two asks (`split`), or a page such as Careers on one action (`panel`), or a page that ends on its one loud ask (`primary`).
avoidWhen: For a newsletter sign-up close → use `closing-call-to-action-newsletter`.
For an ask in the middle of a page → compose `call-to-action` directly.
related: call-to-action` — the framed band this section renders.
closing-call-to-action-newsletter` — the closing band whose ask is a subscribe form.
bestPractices: Place it last on the page, right above `site-footer`, after a hatched `section-gap`.
Set `anchor: 'contact'` so the page's contact links scroll to the close.
In `split`, keep `title` and `titleMuted` to one short line each; `panel` and `primary` do not draw `titleMuted`, and `primary` does not draw `eyebrow`.
